items.title: DeepSeek packaged latent reasoning into one model
items.oneliner: DeepSeek-V4 packages latent reasoning into one deployable model and posts 0.94 on BIG-Bench Hard aggregate.

items.title: SAP froze spending to fund AI
items.oneliner: SAP halted most travel and hiring except AI work. Enterprise AI bills are now hitting real operating budgets.

items.title: CSS became a webmail attack surface
items.oneliner: PortSwigger showed sanitized email CSS can still exfiltrate tokens and keylog users. Webmail defenses are behind the threat.

items.title: Fastmail added an EU data region
items.oneliner: Fastmail now lets customers keep primary mail data in Amsterdam. Data residency just became a product requirement.

items.title: Shopify replaced Redis with MySQL
items.oneliner: Shopify moved inventory reservations from Redis to MySQL and held up at $5.1 million per minute.

items.title: Amazon sidestepped local review for data center
items.oneliner: Amazon used a 45-year-old zoning rule to advance a 56-acre AI data center before residents could object.

items.title: Revision prompting cut LLM update costs
items.oneliner: Revision Prompting claims 80% faster updates and 65% lower costs by patching outputs instead of rerunning prompts.

items.title: Zsh fixed a history loss bug
items.oneliner: A years-long Zsh history truncation bug is fixed in 5.9.2. Shell reliability still depends on boring debugging.

items.title: QEMU got a DirectX 11 driver
items.oneliner: Triton brings DirectX 11 acceleration to QEMU guests, making modern Windows apps in virtual machines far more practical.

items.title: Uber open-sourced its merge queue
items.oneliner: Uber's SubmitQueue parallelizes speculative rebases and validations. Monorepo teams now get a serious reference design.
